name: RSI_MAonRSI_Dual_EA
summary: This EA uses a dual-signal approach combining RSI indicator values with a moving average applied on RSI (MAonRSI) to generate trading signals. It enters long when RSI crosses above its moving average from oversold territory and enters short when RSI crosses below its moving average from overbought territory. The strategy aims to capture momentum shifts while filtering out false signals using the MA-on-RSI confirmation technique.
summary_zh: 该EA采用双重信号方法，结合RSI指标值和应用于RSI上的移动平均线（MAonRSI）来生成交易信号。当RSI从超卖区域上穿其移动平均线时做多，当RSI从超买区域下穿其移动平均线时做空。该策略旨在捕捉动量转换，同时使用MA-on-RSI确认技术过滤假信号。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用RSI指标与其自身移动平均线之间的关系来判断动量方向的变化。入场条件为：做多时，RSI从超卖区域（通常低于30）向上穿越其移动平均线；做空时，RSI从超买区域（通常高于70）向下穿越其移动平均线。这种双重确认机制——既要求RSI处于极端区域又要求穿越均线——旨在减少虚假信号。出场条件通常包括反向交叉信号、固定止盈止损或RSI回到中性区域。仓位管理方面，该EA可能提供固定手数或基于资金的动态仓位计算选项。资金管理方面，由于策略依赖于动量反转信号，在趋势强劲时可能面临连续亏损的风险，因此合理的止损设置和单笔风险控制至关重要。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy leverages the relationship between the RSI indicator and its own moving average to detect momentum direction changes. Entry conditions are: for long positions, RSI crosses above its moving average from the oversold zone (typically below 30); for short positions, RSI crosses below its moving average from the overbought zone (typically above 70). This dual confirmation mechanism—requiring both RSI in extreme territory and a cross of the MA—is designed to reduce false signals. Exit conditions typically include reverse crossover signals, fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels, or RSI returning to neutral territory. Position sizing may include fixed lot or equity-based dynamic calculation options. Regarding money management, since the strategy relies on momentum reversal signals, it may face consecutive losses during strong trends, making proper stop-loss placement and per-trade risk control essential.

parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points per level, 0 for none

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points per level

pros: 双重确认机制（RSI极值+均线穿越）有效减少虚假信号
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数可调性好，便于优化
MA-on-RSI技术是对传统RSI策略的有价值改进，增加了信号平滑性
pros_en: Dual confirmation mechanism (RSI extreme + MA crossover) effectively reduces false signals
Clear and understandable strategy logic with good parameter adjustability for optimization
MA-on-RSI technique is a valuable improvement over traditional RSI strategies, adding signal smoothing
cons: 在强趋势市场中RSI可能长期停留在极端区域导致信号延迟或缺失
缺乏多时间周期确认，单一时间框架容易受到市场噪音干扰
未对交易时段和点差进行过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利成交
cons_en: RSI may stay in extreme zones during strong trends, causing signal delays or missed opportunities
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, making single-timeframe signals susceptible to market noise
No trading session or spread filter, potentially leading to unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
improvements: 增加多时间周期确认，例如在更高时间周期RSI方向一致时才允许入场
添加交易时段过滤和最大点差限制以避免不利成交环境
加入移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能以保护浮动利润
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., only enter when higher-timeframe RSI direction aligns
Add trading session filter and maximum spread limit to avoid unfavorable execution environments
Implement trailing stop functionality to protect floating profits

risk_points: 止盈止损默认值可能为0，意味着没有保护性出场机制
动量反转策略在强趋势中可能产生连续亏损
缺乏持仓数量检查和重复开单保护
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit values may be 0, meaning no protective exit mechanism
Momentum reversal strategy may produce consecutive losses during strong trends
Lacks position count checks and duplicate order protection
